headline: Tetroise mining boost
title: Tetroise | Alpha Boss That Boosts Mining | Palworld Guide
video_script: Here is an easy mining upgrade in Palworld one point zero. Tetroise is an alpha boss you can fight in the Desiccated Dunes, northeast of Duneshelter, with mid game gear. Catch it and it has Mining level four. Its partner skill adds plus one Mining suitability to every other Pal at your base. Grass Pals hit it hard. Will you catch one? Comment below!
description: Tetroise in Palworld 1.0 is a Desiccated Dunes alpha whose partner skill adds plus one Mining to your other base Pals.
